reports.author: the_chemist
reports.subject: Soil analysis — zone 4 (north flat) and meltwater sediment

samples.source: zone 4, north flat, clay soil, 0-10cm depth

findings.radiation: 0.9 uSv/h (surface), 0.3 uSv/h (10cm depth) — safe for planting

contaminants.heavy_metals: none detected (Cd, Pb, Hg, As below detection limits)
contaminants.radionuclides: Cs-137: 8 Bq/kg, Sr-90: 5 Bq/kg — below safety thresholds

findings.texture: clay (70% clay, 20% silt, 10% sand) — poor drainage, high water retention
recommendations: Raised beds for wheat and oats. The clay is the thing that holds the water. The water is the thing that drowns the roots.
Clover cover crop to fix nitrogen. The clover is the thing that feeds the soil. The soil is the thing that feeds the wheat.
Wood ash for potassium. The ash is the thing that is the fire. The fire is the thing that is the home.
Bone meal for phosphorus. The bone is the thing that is the animal. The animal is the thing that is the food.

samples.source: meltwater stream, 1km upstream of zone 4, sediment from streambed

contaminants.radionuclides: Cs-137: 12 Bq/kg, Sr-90: 8 Bq/kg — below safety thresholds, but higher than zone 4 soil

findings.texture: silt loam (60% silt, 30% sand, 10% clay) — ideal for filtration
recommendations: Meltwater is safe for irrigation. The meltwater is the thing that feeds the zones. The zones are the thing the family farms.
Filter meltwater through sand before use. The sand is the thing that catches the silt. The silt is the thing that carries the radiation.
Monitor Cs-137 and Sr-90 levels monthly. The levels are the thing that may rise. The rise is the thing that is not safe.
Use meltwater for zone 4 raised beds. The raised beds are the thing that is not the clay. The clay is the thing that is not the drainage.

key_findings: Zone 4 clay soil is nutrient-poor but safe. The clay is the thing that is the foundation. The foundation is the thing the family builds on.
Meltwater is safe for irrigation but carries slightly higher radionuclides. The meltwater is the thing that is the snowflake. The snowflake is the thing that is the hollow.
Clover and raised beds will improve zone 4 yield. The clover is the thing that is the nitrogen. The nitrogen is the thing that is the wheat.
The snowflake is the thing that is the melt. The melt is the thing that is the water. The water is the thing that is the life.
